Unlike global light transport methods that simulate complex scattering, these models approximate direct lighting and shadows using local shading techniques, often treating the volume as a collection of semi-transparent surfaces defined by gradients [S3, unofficial].

This directly supports the claim that modern implementations combine local shading models with shadow casting (or approximation) techniques to enhance depth perception (appearance).
